question: To celebrate Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav (75 years of India's Independence), to which school did the Government of India donate 50 computers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lycee Moderne Ampefiloha, Madagascar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Government of India donated 50 computers to **Lycee Moderne Ampefiloha** in Madagascar as part of the celebrations for Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav, marking 75 years of India's Independence.
 
• This initiative is part of India's efforts to strengthen bilateral relations with Madagascar and promote educational collaboration.
 
• Lycee Moderne Ampefiloha is a prominent educational institution in Madagascar, known for its contribution to the educational sector in the country.
 
• The donation aims to enhance the digital literacy and educational infrastructure of the school, providing better learning opportunities for its students.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav**

 
 
• Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav is an initiative of the Government of India to celebrate and commemorate 75 years of progressive India and the glorious history of its people, culture, and achievements.
 
• The Mahotsav is dedicated to the people of India who have not only been instrumental in bringing India thus far in its evolutionary journey but also hold within them the power and potential to enable Prime Minister Narendra Modi's vision of activating India 2.0, fueled by the spirit of Atmanirbhar Bharat.
 
• The official journey of Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav commenced on 12th March 2021 which started a 75-week countdown to our 75th anniversary of independence and will end post a year on 15th August 2023.
 
• This Mahotsav is a tribute to the people of India who have been instrumental in shaping India through their tireless efforts and have a vision to make India a self-reliant nation.
 
 
 
• **India-Madagascar Relations**
 
 
• India and Madagascar enjoy friendly and cordial relations.
 
• India has extended several lines of credit to Madagascar for developmental projects and has also provided humanitarian assistance in times of natural disasters.
 
• The bilateral relations between the two countries have been further strengthened through various cultural exchanges and educational initiatives.
 
• India's outreach to Madagascar is part of its broader strategy to enhance its engagement with African countries.
